visualCharacteristics: Row of 3 promotional pods, each a colored panel with an optional image, heading, short description, and one CTA button. Full-width single column on mobile, 3-up on desktop.
contentPattern: One row per pod. Optional image cell (picture only) + body cell (heading + description + CTA link).
usage: Promotional teasers highlighting featured offers or content, shown in a 3-up row.
